hero.h1: 10 Best Rooftop Bars in Bucharest (2026) — Reddit-Backed Guide
hero.subtitle: Bucharest — "Little Paris" — hides some of Eastern Europe's most impressive rooftop bars behind its Belle Époque façades. From the highest restaurant in the city at 136 meters to Old Town terraces overlooking centuries-old churches, here's where to drink above the Romanian capital.

methodology: We analyzed Reddit posts across r/bucuresti, r/AskRomania, r/solotravel, and r/Romania, cross-referenced with The Rooftop Guide's expert rankings, TripAdvisor reviews, and local Romanian travel blogs. Google Maps ratings and review counts were verified in March 2026. We prioritized venues with strong local followings over tourist-only spots.
